{{Quote|In this business, there's no medals for second place&hellip;only corpses.|An SRC officer|<ref name="Heroes & Rogues">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>}}
The '''Space Rescue Corps''' or '''SRC''', and sometime known as the '''New Republic Search and Rescue Corps''', was a search and rescue service that was first established by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and later the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] that was responsible for maintaining the safety of travellers in space and would rescue those in peril.

The service did not change much with the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The rescue vessels of the SRC were easily recognized by a striking red and black pattern. Likewise their uniform was black with red trim.

The ships ''[[Iron Tether]]'' and ''[[Corellian Consort]]'' were part of the SRC fleet before and after the rise of the Empire, respectively. ''[[Pride of Thela]]'' and ''[[No Luck Required]]'' were SRC ships in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

By the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the SRC after the [[Battle of Duro (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Duro]], it ships were used as a covert means of rescuing [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as part of the [[Great River]] project. The [[Catchhawks]] were a team that flew under the Corps.
